_comment: Committed evidence for the ASKAP J183950.5-075635 (ASKAP J1839-0756) bright-epoch adjudication in papers/lptv. Each value carries its source. Recorded 2026-08-14; the CASDA TAP queries were run live 2026-08-14 (see survey/lptv-findings.md for the session log).

discovery_paper.title: The emission of interpulses by a 6.45-hour period coherent radio transient
discovery_paper.note: SBID 57929 in the paper's observation table IS the discovery observation; identical to our detection epoch obs_id ASKAP-57929. Exponential average of the published 0.70->0.03 Jy decay over 15 min = (700-30)/ln(700/30) = 213 mJy, against our peak-search 241 mJy (13% agreement); the forced 164 mJy is beam-attenuated by ~0.68 because the source sits ~5 arcsec from the catalogue position.

casda_catalogue_queries_2026_08_14.note: The blind V catalogue derives from a different (off-state) epoch, so its emptiness rules out a persistent polarized neighbour, not the pulse itself.
